integrity: The proof is self-contained conditional only on the standard string-attractor definition; independent finite verifier supplements, but does not replace, general arguments.
scientific_limitations: Exact three-run binary ordinary string-attractor enumeration only; not all binary words. Conditional uniform mean over fixed-length three-run words. Unindexed equivalent coverage remains possible.
title: All minimum string attractors of three-run binary words and the mean–typical gap
